lessons.title: 3. Frozen Dataclass Config (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Create an immutable `Config` dataclass and a helper that updates via `dataclasses.replace`.

tests.name: test_config
tests.unittest_code:
def test_config(self):
    c = Config('localhost')
    c2 = with_port(c, 8080)
    self.assertEqual(c2.port, 8080)
    self.assertEqual(c.port, 80)
